column1: # Folketingsvalget den 26. April 1920; Tabel 1 (Afstemningen ved Folketingsvalget i de enkelte Opstillingskredse), pages 29-60: the Tilsammen row of each nomination district (kreds), in the order of the storkredse of Tabel 2; columns: kreds page, storkreds, number, name, polling districts, inhabitants 1916, registered voters, voted, invalid or blank

# note (transcriber): pp.29-60. No amtskreds Tilsammen rows, and no Ialt Øernes/Jyllands/Hele Landet rows, are printed on these pages. XVIII is skipped in the printed amtskreds numbering (XVII Vejle, XIX Ringkøbing, XX Ribe). Faroe (p.60, section D) omitted.
# note (transcriber): p.29 prints 1. Kreds (Gentofte) as a single commune row with no Tilsammen
# note (transcriber): p.39 2. Kreds (Odense) is a single row (En Del af Odense Kbst.), no Tilsammen printed
# note (transcriber): INHABITANTS digit partly blotted in print (26 030 / 26 630?); read as 26030
# note (transcriber): 6. Kreds (Vonsild) combines parts of Vejle Amt and Ribe Amt
# note (transcriber): 4. Kreds (Vinderup) combines parts of Viborg Amt and Ringkøbing Amt
